projects.name: SDDOT STIP 2027 (Approved) - Construction Reconstruction
projects.notes: One layer per improvement category of the approved STIP map; the layer itself is the work type. Most relevant for land acquisition (grading, reconstruction). No status field: everything here is programmed, not yet built. FiscalYear and ConstructionYear are text years; LettingDate is often null. EstCost is dollars. Other fields: HwyNbr, BegMRMNbr/EndMRMNbr (mile markers), SegmentLen, FundCat1-5, ProjectList (control number + project number), ProjectManager, ReadyDate. MapCategory sample value 'Con/Recon'. Coordinates are a South Dakota projected system (ask for outSR=4326). ConstructionYear values on this layer: '2027', '2027 & 2028', '2027 - 2029', '2028', '2028 & 2029', '2029', '2029 & 2030', '2030', '2030 & 2031'.

projects.name: SDDOT STIP 2027 (Approved) - Local Structure Projects
projects.notes: County/local bridge projects; different field set (has ProjectNbr and TranspProjectStatusCode; only the value 'Recommended' was seen in a sample, the full list was not pulled). Layer 11 (Local Road Projects, 4 lines) and layer 9 (Railroad Crossings, 41 points) are similar small layers.

parcels_counties.notes: Rapid City / Pennington County open data tax parcels. The owner is the 'Grantee' (current deed holder): company names sit whole in GranteeLastName (e.g. 'LINK REALTY HOLDINGS LLC'), people are split into last/first/initial. 54,400 of 54,804 have a GranteeLastName. Grantor* fields are the previous owner. TaxID is the assessor id. No restriction stated on the service.

NOT VERIFIED: listed on ArcGIS Online as the county's 'MCParcels' layer, but the server did not answer (connection timed out on two attempts, 2026-11-17). Fields unknown. The City of Sioux Falls server (https://gis.siouxfalls.gov/arcgis/rest/services/Data/Property/MapServer/1) also timed out; the city's hosted 'Parcels with Property Taxes 2026' layer did answer but has no owner field.
NOT VERIFIED: the server answered HTTP 403 Forbidden to a plain request. Fields unknown.

summary: Projects work well: SDDOT's approved STIP map service gives planned projects as lines per category with cost, year and county. No statewide owner parcels; of the big counties only Pennington (Rapid City) was verified with owner and mailing address - Minnehaha and Sioux Falls servers timed out and Lincoln refused the request. Brown and Brookings were not checked.
parcels_statewide_reason: No free statewide parcel layer with owner names was found on the state servers checked (sdgis.sd.gov hosted services, the State of South Dakota ArcGIS Online organisation); parcels are published county by county.
